title: Umbral Manipulations
subtitle: Tenebris - blood remembers shadow
text: Umbral blood has absorbed long hours in darkness. Void Shroud (QUICK, 100) cloaks you with invisibility. Umbral Step (QUICK, 300) teleports to a safe dark target space, and Black Veil Covenant can satisfy that darkness. Blood Eclipse (QUICK, 300) blinds and harms enemies in a cone. Black Veil Covenant (QUICK, 425) raises a temporary black-veined sphere that behaves as synthetic darkness. Umbral Reversal (QUICK, 375) slips backward into nearby darkness and blinds pursuers. Blood Eclipse Mantle (QUICK, 325) grants resistance and fire protection while weakening your attacks.
